briefdescription.para: Given a virtual register Reg, return the corresponding VNInfo for it.

detaileddescription.para: This will return nullptr if the virtual register is an implicit_def or if LiveIntervals is not available.

briefdescription.para: Return true if this is 'vsetvli x0, x0, vtype' which preserves VL and only sets VTYPE.
Get the EEW for a load or store instruction.

detaileddescription.para: Return std::nullopt if MI is not a load or store which ignores SEW.

briefdescription.para: Return true if this is an operation on mask registers.

detaileddescription.para: Note that this includes both arithmetic/logical ops and load/store (vlm/vsm).

briefdescription.para: Return true if the inactive elements in the result are entirely undefined.

detaileddescription.para: Note that this is different from "agnostic" as defined by the vector specification. Agnostic requires each lane to either be undisturbed, or take the value -1; no other value is allowed.

briefdescription.para: Return true if MI is a copy that will be lowered to one or more vmvNr.vs.
Return true if moving from CurVType to NewVType is indistinguishable from the perspective of an instruction (or set of instructions) which use only the Used subfields and properties.
Return the fields and properties demanded by the provided instruction.
